english.notes:
THIS OFFENCE IS NOW OBSOLETE

(i) The consent of the Director of Public Prosecutions is required to prosecute this offence or the attempt.
(ii) See also associated offence wordings as follows: H2147 and H586 where the victim is under 13 years of age/an attempt to commit this offence.
(iii) This offence is included in Schedule 1(1) to the Sex Offenders Act 1997, therefore a person convicted or cautioned for this offence must (subject to the exceptions and provisions contained in Schedule 1(2) and (3)) comply with the requirements of section 2 of that Act.
(iv) Repealed by s.140 of and Schedule 7 to the Sexual Offences Act 2003
(v) This offence is obselete with no exact modern equivalent. Historical records must be reviewed case-by-case and graded/retained according to the modern equivalent, taking into account individual case circumstances, victim capacity and consent, and ages of victim and offender.
